summary: Iteration 2 (Assets sidebar + bulk upload + drag-to-canvas) fully verified. 5/5 new backend pytest cases pass against GET/DELETE /api/assets. Frontend Playwright run validates right-sidebar (assets/block tabs), AssetsPanel with bulk upload (multiple files via input[multiple]), draggable asset tiles, HTML5 drag-drop creating an image block on page-drop-zone-0, auto-switching to Block tab on selection (BlockProperties panel visible) and back to Assets on deselect, and asset-delete removing the tile.

issues: Delete button only visible on hover (opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100) - acceptable but touch/keyboard users may not discover it

critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/files/{path} returns 404 for soft-deleted files (good); but previously-embedded image_url references in books that pointed to a now-deleted asset will silently 404 in the editor. Consider returning placeholder or warning in book GET when image_path is soft-deleted.
AssetsPanel handleFiles uploads serially in a for-await loop; for 10+ files this is slow. Consider Promise.all with concurrency cap (e.g. 4).

AssetsPanel container has onDragOver/onDrop that intercepts drops even when a tile is dragged out from the panel - currently only triggers for files (e.dataTransfer.files?.length), but the dragging visual state can briefly toggle when dragging tiles within the panel. Minor UX nit.
Editor.jsx is now ~700 lines (PageCanvas + PageThumbnail inlined) - approaching the 700-line guidance threshold; split PageCanvas/PageThumbnail into separate files.

PageCanvas handleDrop reads dataTransfer.getData(ASSET_DRAG_MIME) || getData('text/plain'); if a user drags arbitrary text into the page canvas containing 'http...', JSON.parse will throw and silently return - that's handled, but consider stricter MIME-only validation.

Both AssetsPanel and the top-bar Image button upload images but only top-bar Image button triggers an immediate block insertion; uploads done via Assets panel correctly appear in the grid but the assets panel does not auto-refresh in other open tabs (no websocket) - acceptable for MVP.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (right sidebar, tabs, bulk upload, drag-drop, block tab switch, asset delete all verified)

seed_data_creation: Uploaded TEST_asset_*.png and TEST_bulk_*.png assets and created TEST_AssetsSidebar book; the book was deleted at end of run. Uploaded assets remain in DB but are soft-deleted where required by tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend assets tests at /app/backend/tests/test_assets_api.py. ASSET_DRAG_MIME='application/x-bindery-asset'. The drag-drop was verified via page.evaluate dispatching synthetic DragEvent with DataTransfer (real Playwright .drag_to() is unreliable here). page-drop-zone-0 has onDrop handler that creates an image block via addImageBlockFromAsset; the block is rendered as an inside [data-testid='page-canvas-0']. Block tab auto-switches via useEffect on selectedBlockId. REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://book-builder-69.preview.emergentagent.com
